rationale: This is a transitive build-tooling dependency of the static Astro website. The application declares no server output or adapter; only HTML, CSS and authored assets from app/dist are published. No server-side JavaScript or shared response cache is deployed. Retain the existing review deadline and advisory scope; reconsider when the compatible upstream dependency is fixed.
